We are looking for an experienced Senior Ecommerce Manager to join Hårklinikken as we continue to develop and grow our global ecommerce business.

We operate six Shopify sites across the US, UK, EU, Denmark, Iceland and the UAE, with the US representing our largest growth market.

You will own how we present and sell Hårklinikken online, shaping a seamless and engaging experience that helps clients explore our offerings, find what is right for their individual needs and take the next step in their journey with us.

At the same time, you will own the sales plan and use data and customer behaviour to identify opportunities, improve conversion and continuously optimise the online experience. From merchandising and product launches to CRO, consultation booking, first purchase and the ecommerce roadmap, you will be responsible for making our sites commercially strong, seamless and easy to use.

Success in this role means delivering against the sales plan and continuously improving conversion rate, AOV and revenue across sites and markets.

Alongside commercial performance, you will ensure our sites are fast, stable and easy to use, working closely with our web agency and tech team to continuously improve the experience for our clients.

Primary Relationships

You will report to the Global Director of Ecommerce and work closely with the CRM & Lifecycle Manager as part of our ecommerce team in Copenhagen.

You will also collaborate closely with Brand, our clinics and Operations, particularly around merchandising, launches and the customer journey.

Externally, you will work closely with our web agency, technology team and relevant ecommerce partners.

Key Responsibilities

• Trading across six sites. Own the sales plan for each site, with campaigns and offers adapted to each market, and contribute to ecommerce forecasts throughout the year.

• Merchandising and launches. Determine what we feature and where to drive effective cross-sell and upsell. Coordinate online product launches with Brand, clinics and Operations, while keeping stock availability and our delivery promise on track.

• The CRO roadmap. Identify where we lose clients, develop and run tests, and roll out what works.

• The ecommerce backlog. Set priorities together with the Global Director of Ecommerce, brief our web agency and tech team, and manage incoming website requests, including knowing when to say no.

• The first step of the customer journey. Own and optimise the consultation booking flow, sign-ups, onsite offers and first purchase, in close collaboration with the CRM & Lifecycle Manager.

• E-tailers, SEO and GEO. Manage the day-to-day activities and relationships with relevant external partners.

Core Competencies

This role requires strong ecommerce experience combined with a hands-on, structured and analytical approach. You are comfortable owning your numbers, identifying problems through data and translating insights into clear priorities and actions.

You enjoy taking ownership and making decisions. You are comfortable saying no to the wrong request when necessary and can clearly explain the reasoning behind your priorities.

You don’t need to tick every box to be the right fit. We would love to hear from you if you bring strong ecommerce experience, a commercial mindset and a genuine drive to continuously improve the customer experience.

What You Bring:

• 5+ years of experience in ecommerce, with full ownership of a webshop’s trading and conversion.

• Deep Shopify experience, ideally Shopify Plus across multiple storefronts or markets.

• Experience with subscriptions in ecommerce, ideally Recharge.

• A strong CRO track record, with experience running tests and demonstrating their impact without compromising the brand.

• Strong GA4 and Shopify analytics capabilities, with the ability to identify problems and opportunities through data before looking for a solution.

• Experience leading agencies and developers through a roadmap and backlog.

• Fluent English.

• A structured approach, strong ownership of your numbers and the confidence to prioritise and say no when needed.

It is an advantage if you also have:

• Hands-on Amazon experience, ideally Seller Central in the US.

• Experience working with the US market.

• Experience working with a premium brand within beauty, wellness, fashion or lifestyle.

• Proficiency in a Scandinavian language.

Who Are We?

Founded in 1992 in Copenhagen, Hårklinikken is a leading scalp and hair health clinic with more than 30 years of experience. We help clients achieve optimal scalp health and long-lasting hair gain, combining expert guidance with clean and gentle products formulated to support healthy hair growth.

Our approach began with Hårklinikken’s founder and lead researcher, Lars Skjøth, who developed a diagnostic, consultation-based approach centred around understanding each client’s individual scalp and hair needs. Today, The Hårklinikken Method brings together decades of expertise with the personalised care that has been at the heart of Hårklinikken from the beginning.

Clients come to us in different ways, whether through a consultation or by discovering and purchasing our products online. Through virtual consultations or in person at our clinics in New York, Beverly Hills, Copenhagen, Aarhus, Dubai and Reykjavik, our Hair Specialists combine their expertise with an individual assessment of each client’s scalp, hair, lifestyle and environment to create a personalised regimen designed around their specific needs.

However their journey begins, we are here to guide and support our clients along the way. From helping them find what is right for their individual needs to supporting them in achieving the best possible results, we want every client to feel confident, understood and cared for throughout their Hårklinikken journey.

We’re on a mission to help as many people as possible achieve fuller, stronger, healthier hair with products that are powered by science, perfected by experts and proven by over 100,000 clients.

What We Offer

• A new team, where you shape how we work from day one

• Full ownership of six sites in six markets

• Short decision paths in an owner-led company

• Close work with our clinics, where the treatment starts

• A real work-life balance, with flexibility in how you plan your day

• An international team and modern clinics with a strong focus on quality and aesthetics

• Growth opportunities in a safe work environment

• Pension, holiday allowance and discounts on our products and treatments

The role reports to the Global Director of Ecommerce and is based on site in Copenhagen. It is a permanent, full-time position, starting as soon as possible.

Questions? Contact Emma Cronwall Trampedach at +45 3133 5432.

Equal Employment Opportunities

We offer equal employment opportunity to qualified individuals without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We strongly believe that cultivating a diverse workplace gives a company strength. The combination of unique skills, abilities, experiences, and backgrounds creates an environment that produces extraordinary results.

Experienced Oracle database developer at Novo Nordisk Engineering

The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

jobs.description:
**Your impact begins here

**As Associate Consumer Finance & Online Partnerships Director, you will build the financial foundation for how Novo grows online partnerships in Obesity across Europe and Canada (EUCAN). This is a newly created role: you will set up a European customer profit and loss view and a clear business case approach, so teams know where to invest and can track the return. You will turn complex analysis into decisions that help more people reach treatment.

**What You’ll Bring

**You thrive where commercial business development, consumer behaviour and financial decision making meet. You can build something new, influence without formal authority and turn complexity into action.

• A master’s degree in economics, business administration, finance or an equivalent field.

• Significant experience in commercial finance, business development, M&A finance, financial system change projects or customer profitability, including cross-country, regional or global exposure.

• Strong financial modelling and data interpretation skills.

• Practical experience in pricing, negotiation, customer profitability and stakeholder management in a large organisation.

• Experience bringing structure to new business areas, setting clear priorities and steering the business through influence and relationships.

• The ability to turn complex analysis into clear recommendations and to build new capabilities, standards and frameworks from the ground up.

• Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, AI modelling, SAP and systematic data consolidation.

• Fluency in English.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Experience from consumer health companies, including private healthcare organisations.

• Additional languages.

**What You’ll Do

**You will be the finance partner who helps Region Europe and Canada decide where to invest in online partnerships and consumer initiatives, and who shows what those investments deliver.

• Create the framework and shape commercial partnership priorities through sound financial modelling, working with business partners to assess partnership opportunities and consumer investment initiatives.

• Develop and deliver a business case methodology across European markets, so investment decisions are prudent, comparable and grounded in facts as part of the business rhythm.

• Establish an end-to-end view of customer and partner profit and loss, including system tracking and performance updates that follow return on investment.

• Deliver complex cross-functional change projects with Business Development, Finance, Legal, Supply Chain and Commercial Strategy to enable online sales in new European markets.

• Act as Commercial Finance Partner to the commercial unit for business development and to the UK affiliate.

• Improve data definitions, ownership, quality and comparability of online sales channels across markets.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the Business Finance team in Region Europe and Canada (EUCAN), part of International Operations, reporting to the Director of Business Finance. The team is a key business partner to the Regional Leadership Team and the European sales affiliates.

Day to day, you will collaborate with European sales affiliate offices, local finance and business development teams, and with colleagues in Marketing, Business Development and Commercial Excellence, Data, Insights & Analytics, Pricing and Access, and Supply Chain. You will build bridges between these functions, so every investment decision rests on evidence and aims to maximise patient reach. Working across markets, you will help drive both the online sales agenda and the consumer finance agenda in Obesity.

The role is based in Ørestad, Copenhagen, Denmark.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will shape a new area from the start, with the trust to set direction and the visibility to influence decisions across European markets. Working with colleagues from finance, commercial, legal and supply chain, you will broaden your perspective across the value chain and build new skills through practical, cross-functional experience.

You will be supported to perform at your best, with clear expectations and a culture that values honest input and follows through on decisions.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 847,010.00 to 1,245,110.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to build the financial foundation for online partnerships across Europe, apply for the Associate Director, Consumer Finance & Online Partnerships role by 22 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Job title: Senior Principal Scientist – Molecular Innovation and Discovery

Department: Global Research

Location: Måløv, Denmark

**Your impact begins here

**As Senior Principal Scientist, you will play a key role in building a new interdisciplinary team in Global Research and contribute to shape how it turns emerging biology into molecular interventions. You will co-create new therapeutic concepts in cardiometabolic disease and healthspan, design the molecules that test them and establish their pharmacological potential. Your work will bring new projects into the early discovery pipeline, because lasting health starts with the science we build today.

**What You Will Bring

**You hold a PhD in medicinal chemistry, chemical biology, molecular pharmacology, peptide chemistry or a related discipline, typically complemented by at least eight years of relevant post-PhD research experience, or equivalent scientific contributions and leadership. Relevant experience may come from academia, biotechnology or the pharmaceutical industry.

• Deep expertise in molecular design and a strong understanding of how molecular properties influence pharmacological activity.

• A record of turning original ideas into experimental tools, therapeutic candidates or discovery projects, evidenced through publications, patents, project progression or other relevant contributions.

• Experience connecting chemistry with biological assays and in vivo findings to guide molecular optimisation.

• The ability to evaluate therapeutic modalities and select approaches suited to the target, mechanism and intended site of action.

• Experience leading scientific work and influencing decisions across multidisciplinary collaborations.

• Creativity, sound scientific judgement and a willingness to pursue unfamiliar approaches while testing assumptions rigorously.

• Clear scientific communication in written and spoken English.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Peptide engineering, peptide–drug conjugates or targeted delivery.

• Multi-receptor pharmacology or approaches combining complementary mechanisms.

• Neuropharmacology, cardiometabolic disease or healthspan research.

• Receptor pharmacology and mechanistic assay development.

• Collaborations connecting molecular design, synthesis and biological evaluation.

You are not expected to bring expertise across every modality or therapeutic area.

**What You Will Do

**You will provide scientific leadership at the interface of molecular design, biology and experimental pharmacology.

• Originate therapeutic concepts that connect biological mechanisms with opportunities for molecular intervention, and design molecular tools and drug candidates to establish pharmacological proof of concept.

• Develop strategies involving peptides, small molecules, conjugates or other modalities, choosing the approach that fits the biological question.

• Guide iterative molecular design using findings from in vitro assays, in vivo pharmacology and relevant DMPK studies.

• Contribute hands-on to experimental research, such as molecular preparation, characterisation or pharmacological evaluation, according to project needs and available capabilities.

• Identify technologies that expand our ability to modulate biological targets or deliver pharmacological activity.

• Assess evidence critically and recommend which concepts to advance, redirect or discontinue.

• Mentor colleagues and communicate molecular strategies, findings and recommendations across disciplines.

**Who You Will Work With

**You will join a new interdisciplinary team in Global Research within Research & Development, combining expertise in physiology, pharmacology, neuroscience and molecular innovation. Day to day, you will work closely with scientists and laboratory technicians. The team, headed by Christoffer Clemmensen, is currently recruiting at multiple levels, so you contribute to shape the new team from the onset.

You are expected to establish close collaborations across the organisation with colleagues in chemistry, biology, DMPK and relevant technology functions to develop and test new therapeutic concepts. Bringing these perspectives together early helps the team make clear, evidence-based decisions at pace.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will shape the molecular innovation agenda of a new team and contribute to its first generation of discovery projects. The role combines scientific ownership with close involvement in experimental work, using emerging biological findings to guide the development of molecular approaches.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn emerging biology into molecular approaches that can change what we know about cardiometabolic disease and healthspan, apply for the Senior Principal Scientist – Molecular Innovation and Discovery role by 22 November 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so apply as soon as you can.
